description: Na₂HPO₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.80 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.58 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-52°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.65 Å. H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.03 Å) and one longer (1.58 Å) H-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one P, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one P, and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃P trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one P atom.
